summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd (formerly Sayona Mining Ltd) filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 31, 2026, furnishing its Appendix 4E Preliminary Final Report, Annual Report, and FY26 results materials filed with the ASX on August 28, 2026. The filing discloses FY2026 results: revenue of $201.7M (up 39%), net profit of $43.1M versus a prior-year loss, and no dividends. It also notes the completion of the Piedmont Lithium merger on August 30, 2025, forming a ~50:50 lithium producer. This is a routine periodic financial report, not a special-situation event; no transaction terms, premiums, or strategic actions are present.
